subtitle: Your ROMs and BizHawk, ready for Archipelago

legal.title: ArchipelaGOAT does not provide any ROM.
legal.body: Use your own copies. The vault only keeps their path and fingerprint: nothing is copied, nothing is shared.

vault.title: ROM vault
vault.emptyBody: Choose the folder where you keep your ROMs: ArchipelaGOAT recognises the ones Archipelago expects from their MD5 fingerprint.

apply.hint: The path of each recognised ROM is written to Archipelago’s settings (host.yaml).

list.unknownHint: Their fingerprint matches no ROM Archipelago expects: another region or revision, a modified ROM, or a game that does not need one.
list.removeHint: Remove from the vault. The file stays on your disk.

bizhawk.title: BizHawk
bizhawk.lead: The emulator Archipelago drives for Game Boy, GBA, NES, SNES and N64 games (Pokémon, Mega Man, Castlevania…).
bizhawk.missingBody: Install version {{version}} in one click, or point to a BizHawk you already have.
bizhawk.configureHint: Archipelago will know where BizHawk is and will open the patched ROM in it directly.

prereqKinds.mono: Mono, which runs BizHawk on Linux
prereqKinds.lua: Lua 5.4, for the Archipelago connection script
prereqKinds.lsb: lsb_release, used by the BizHawk launcher

bizhawk.commandHint: Run it in a terminal, then check again.
bizhawk.linkHint: Install it from the official page, then check again.

games.title: Supported games
games.lead: The ROMs Archipelago 0.6.8 recognises, in the exact version it expects.
games.generationHint: The host needs it to generate the game.
games.playHint: Only the player needs it, to patch their game.
